text_en: These are the stages by which the Israelites went out of the land of Egypt in military formation under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
text_cn: 以下是以色列子民在梅瑟和亚郎指挥下，分队出离埃及国后所行的路程。

text_en: Moses wrote down their starting points, stage by stage, by command of the Lord ; and these are their stages according to their starting places.
text_cn: 梅瑟记录了他们遵上主的命启营的出发点。以下是他们依次出发的行程：

text_en: They set out from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the day after the passover the Israelites went out boldly in the sight of all the Egyptians,
text_cn: 他们于正月十五日由辣默色斯起程，即在逾越节第二日，以色列子民大胆地、当着众埃及人的面出走了，

text_en: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the Lord had struck down among them. The Lord executed judgments even against their gods.
text_cn: 其时埃及人正在埋葬上主在他们中所击杀的一切长子；上主也惩罚了他们的神祇。

text_en: So the Israelites set out from Rameses, and camped at Succoth.
text_cn: 以色列子民由辣默色斯起程，在稣苛特扎营。

text_en: They set out from Succoth, and camped at Etham, which is on the edge of the wilderness.
text_cn: 由稣苛特起程，在位于旷野边界的厄堂扎营。

text_en: They set out from Etham, and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which faces Baal-zephon; and they camped before Migdol.
text_cn: 由厄堂起程，转向巴耳责丰的丕哈希洛特，在米革多耳对面扎营。

text_en: They set out from Pi-hahiroth, passed through the sea into the wilderness, went a three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and camped at Marah.
text_cn: 由丕哈希洛特起程，由海中经过进入旷野，在厄堂旷野中行了三天的路，然后在玛辣扎营。

text_en: They set out from Marah and came to Elim; at Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
text_cn: 由玛辣起程，来到厄林。在厄林有十二水泉和七十株棕榈树，就在那里扎营。

text_en: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
text_cn: 由厄林起程，在红海旁扎营。

text_en: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
text_cn: 由红海起程，在欣旷野扎营。

text_en: They set out from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
text_cn: 由欣旷野起程，在多弗卡扎营。

text_en: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
text_cn: 由多弗卡起程，在阿路士扎营。

text_en: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
text_cn: 由阿路士起程，在勒非丁扎营；民众在这里没有水喝。

text_en: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
text_cn: 由勒非丁起程，在西乃旷野扎营。

text_en: They set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
text_cn: 由西乃旷野起程，在克贝洛特哈塔瓦扎营。

text_en: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
text_cn: 由克贝洛特哈塔瓦起程，在哈责洛特扎营。

text_en: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
text_cn: 由哈责洛特起程，在黎特玛扎营。

text_en: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
text_cn: 由黎特玛起程，在黎孟培勒兹扎营。

text_en: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
text_cn: 由黎孟培勒兹起程，在里贝纳扎营。

text_en: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
text_cn: 由里贝纳起程，在黎撒扎营。

text_en: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
text_cn: 由黎撒起程，在刻黑拉达扎营。

text_en: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
text_cn: 由刻黑拉达起程，在舍斐尔山扎营。

text_en: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
text_cn: 由舍斐尔山起程，在哈辣达扎营。

text_en: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
text_cn: 由哈辣达起程，在玛刻黑罗特扎营。

text_en: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
text_cn: 由玛刻黑罗特起程，在塔哈特扎营。

text_en: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
text_cn: 由塔哈特起程，在特辣黑扎营。

text_en: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
text_cn: 由特辣黑起程，在米特卡扎营。

text_en: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
text_cn: 由米特卡起程，在哈市摩纳扎营。

text_en: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
text_cn: 由哈市摩纳起程，在摩色尔扎营。

text_en: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
text_cn: 由摩色尔起程，在贝乃雅干扎营。

text_en: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
text_cn: 由贝乃雅干起程，在曷尔哈基加得扎营。

text_en: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
text_cn: 由曷尔哈基加得起程，在约特巴达扎营。

text_en: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
text_cn: 由约特巴达起程，在阿贝洛纳扎营。

text_en: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
text_cn: 由阿贝洛纳起程，在厄兹雍革贝尔扎营。

text_en: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin (that is, Kadesh).
text_cn: 由厄兹雍革贝尔起程，在亲旷野，即卡德士扎营。

text_en: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.
text_cn: 由卡德士起程，在位于厄东地边界上的曷尔山下扎营。

text_en: Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor at the command of the Lord and died there in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.
text_cn: 亚郎大司祭依上主的命，上了曷尔山，死在那里，时在以色列子民出埃及国后四十年五月初一日。

text_en: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.
text_cn: 亚郎死在曷尔山上时，已一百二十三岁。

text_en: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the Negeb in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the Israelites.
text_cn: 其时住在客纳罕南部的客纳罕人王阿辣得，听说以色列子民来了。

text_en: They set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
text_cn: 他们再由曷尔山下起程，在匝耳摩纳扎营。

text_en: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
text_cn: 由匝耳摩纳起程，在普农扎营。

text_en: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
text_cn: 由普农起程，在敖波特扎营。

text_en: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim, in the territory of Moab.
text_cn: 由敖波特起程，在位于摩阿布边境的依因阿巴陵扎营。

text_en: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
text_cn: 由依因阿巴陵起程，在狄朋加得扎营。

text_en: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
text_cn: 由狄朋加得起程，在阿耳孟狄贝拉塔因扎营。

text_en: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
text_cn: 由阿耳孟狄贝拉塔因起程，在乃波前面的阿巴陵山地内扎营。

text_en: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho;
text_cn: 由阿巴陵山地起程，在耶里哥对面，约但河边，摩阿布旷野扎营；

text_en: they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
text_cn: 他们在摩阿布旷野里，沿着约但河边扎营，由贝特耶史摩特直到阿贝耳史廷。

text_en: In the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 在耶里哥对面，约但河边，摩阿布旷野内，上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Speak to the Israelites, and say to them: When you cross over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：你们几时过了约但河，进入客纳罕地，

text_en: you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their figured stones, destroy all their cast images, and demolish all their high places.
text_cn: 应由你们面前驱逐当地所有的居民，应毁坏他们的一切偶像，应打碎他们的一切铸像，应铲除他们的一切丘坛。

text_en: You shall take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
text_cn: 你们要占领那地方，住在那里，因为我已将那地方给了你们，叫你们占有。

text_en: You shall apportion the land by lot according to your clans; to a large one you shall give a large inheritance, and to a small one you shall give a small inheritance; the inheritance shall belong to the person on whom the lot falls; according to your ancestral tribes you shall inherit.
text_cn: 你们要按支派抽签分配那地方：人数多的多给，人数少的少给。谁的签落在哪里，哪里就属于他。你们依照宗祖支派分配你们的产业。

text_en: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those whom you let remain shall be as barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they shall trouble you in the land where you are settling.
text_cn: 但是，如果你们不把当地的居民由你们面前驱逐，那留下的居民，必要成为你们的眼中刺，腰间针，在你们住的地方内迫害你们；

text_en: And I will do to you as I thought to do to them.
text_cn: 并且我打算了怎样对待他们，也要怎样对待你们。”
